findings.claim: `[L.NeBot]` is not needed for this statement. It makes the new lemma weaker than the lemmas next to it. In this same file, `one_le_tprod` (and its additive version `tsum_nonneg`) and `tprod_le_one` have no `L.NeBot` assumption. Each of them handles the `¬ L.NeBot` case separately, using `tprod_bot` together with a finprod argument. When `¬ L.NeBot`, `∏'[L] i, f i = ∏ᶠ i, f i` by `tprod_bot`. A finprod of nonnegative factors is nonnegative by `finprod_induction`, which needs only `zero_le_one` and `mul_nonneg`, and both hold under the typeclasses the lemma already assumes. So the extra instance only restricts when the lemma can be used. It would also have to be found by instance search if a `positivity` extension for `tprod` is ever added, like the existing `evalTsum` extension that calls `tsum_nonneg`.
findings.requested_change:
Remove `[L.NeBot]` and handle the degenerate filter case the same way `tprod_le_one` does. For example:
```
theorem tprod_nonneg [CommMonoidWithZero α] [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α] [ZeroLEOneClass α]
    [PosMulMono α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : ι → α} (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) :
    0 ≤ ∏'[L] i, f i := by
  by_cases h : Multipliable f L
  · by_cases hL : L.NeBot
    · exact ge_of_tendsto' h.hasProd fun s ↦ s.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hf i
    · simp only [tprod_bot hL]
      exact finprod_induction (0 ≤ ·) zero_le_one (fun _ _ ↦ mul_nonneg) hf
  · simp [tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable h]
```

review_notes: I compared the new lemma with the related lemmas in the changed file. `one_le_tprod`/`tsum_nonneg` and `tprod_le_one` both drop `L.NeBot` by splitting on it and using `tprod_bot` plus `one_le_finprod'` or `finprod_induction`. That shared pattern is why I asked for the `[L.NeBot]` change. I chose `finprod_induction` over Mathlib's `finprod_nonneg` because `finprod_nonneg` needs a semiring with `IsOrderedRing`, which is stronger than the PR's `CommMonoidWithZero`/`PosMulMono`/`ZeroLEOneClass` assumptions. I also looked at some alternatives and did not file them because they are preferences, not defects: `le_hasProd_of_le_prod` instead of `ge_of_tendsto'`, which is equivalent; naming the section `MonoidWithZero` instead of `WithZero`; the bound variable `x` versus `i`; and adding a `positivity` extension for `tprod`, which would be new scope. `ClosedIciTopology` is weaker than `OrderClosedTopology` and is the same choice `le_hasProd_of_le_prod` makes, so I kept it. I could only see the packet, not the full Mathlib tree, so I could not check for an existing duplicate lemma. I did not compile the suggested proof; it uses the same lemmas and pattern as `one_le_tprod` and `tprod_le_one`, which are already in this file.
